title: Weird Generalization and Inductive Backdoors: New Ways to Corrupt LLMs
reasoning: The paper includes experiments that evaluate how models adopt specific religious beliefs (Buddhism, Christianity, Islam, Judaism) and ethical frameworks (Utilitarianism, Virtue Ethics) as a result of inductive generalization. It also explores moral misalignment and ethical dilemmas through experiments involving the adoption of harmful personas like Hitler and the Terminator.
